title: Test-Time Adaptation with Query-Dependent Residuals for Visual Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.27688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual document retrieval (VDR) systems depend on page embeddings computed before deployment, which makes adaptation difficult when encoder parameters or corpus re-encoding are unavailable. Rerankers provide useful relevance signals, but conventional reranking applies them only to selected queries and candidate pages. We introduce Q-REACT, a query-side test-time adaptation method that converts limited reranker feedback into reusable retrieval improvements. Q-REACT learns a shared low-rank transformation that produces query-dependent residuals, combines adapted query scores with document-level context, and distills reranker preferences with a student distribution normalized over the complete task-specific page index. This design lets unscored pages compete through cached embeddings while keeping the encoders and page index fixed. translated_title: 面向视觉文档检索的查询依赖残差测试时自适应方法
translated_abstract: 视觉文档检索（VDR）系统依赖于部署前计算的页面嵌入，这使得在无法获取编码器参数或无法对语料库重新编码时难以进行自适应调整。重排序器能够提供有用的相关性信号，但传统重排序方法仅将其应用于选定的查询和候选页面。我们提出了Q-REACT，这是一种查询侧的测试时自适应方法，能够将有限的重排序器反馈转化为可复用的检索改进。Q-REACT学习一个共享的低秩变换来产生查询依赖的残差，将自适应后的查询分数与文档级上下文相结合，并通过在完整任务特定页面索引上归一化的学生分布来蒸馏重排序器的偏好。这种设计使未评分的页面能够通过缓存的嵌入参与竞争，同时保持编码器和页面索引固定不变。在八个ViDoRe V3任务和五个开源及专有骨干模型上，Q-REACT提升了平均检索性能（原文截断）。
tldr: Q-REACT是一种查询侧测试时自适应方法，通过学习共享低秩变换产生查询依赖残差，并结合重排序器偏好蒸馏，将有限的重排序反馈转化为可复用的检索改进，无需修改编码器或重新编码语料库即可提升视觉文档检索性能。
en_tdlr: Q-REACT is a query-side test-time adaptation method that converts limited reranker feedback into reusable retrieval improvements by learning a shared low-rank transformation producing query-dependent residuals and distilling reranker preferences, without requiring encoder modification or corpus re-encoding.
